description: This is a PHP source code file defining the FilterFactory class used to create and manage filter instances for connectors in the SuiteCRM project. It includes logic for loading specific filter classes based on source and filter names, checking for override files, and caching created filters.

classes.name: FilterFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and caching filter objects based on source and filter names within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Main method to retrieve a filter object instance based on the source name and optional filter name, involving loading the appropriate filter class file, or defaulting to 'default_filter'.
